_meta.note: First-pass roster from Wikipedia; cross-check against a second source before relying on it.

audit.design: Stratified random sample: 4 leaders, 20 district/at-large, 8 party-list, each checked by a research agent against non-Wikipedia sources (news, election results, member pages).
audit.seats: No wrong seat found. 30 fully confirmed; 2 only partly sourced (Kathryn Joyce Gorriceta: current service; Richelle Singson-Michael: name not found on an opened 2025-26 page).
audit.party: Differences from 2025 election labels for several members (e.g. Pascual, Javier, Atayde, Gonzales); some are documented 2026 party switches (e.g. Matugas, Villa to PFP). Treat party as 'as of' the roster date.
audit.dates: Wikipedia's 'took office' dates were unreliable (e.g. Mendoza has served since 2007; Hernandez's date is his Senior Deputy Speaker post), so records now use the 20th Congress start (2025-06-30) or a later mid-term date.
audit.roles: Leadership roles are incomplete (e.g. Suarez, Santos, Uy hold posts not in the roster table).
audit.flags: Two sampled members face court proceedings reported by news outlets (charges are allegations, not findings); not yet recorded on the site.
